top_violation_types.title: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2985) (26 TAC §746.901(4))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Notarized affidavit was missing on file for one out of four staff files checked.

top_violation_types.title: Health Statement parent sign - Dated within past yr, name/address health care professional, states child can participate. Follow by signed statement (26 TAC §746.611(a)(3))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One  record reviewed with a Health Statement indicating one will be obtained within 12 months of enrollment and was not obtained. Enrollment date showed 1/17/24.

top_violation_types.title: Documentation of Drills (26 TAC §746.5205(4))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Re-cite: Documentation of drills was not available for review at the time of inspection.

top_violation_types.title: Required Personnel Records (26 TAC §746.901)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One out of four employee records evaluated was unavailable for review.     One out of four employee records evaluated was incomplete.

top_violation_types.title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation knowingly allowed persons to be present at the operation before receiving notification from the CBCU that the persons eligibility determination is Eligible, Provisional or Eligible with Conditions.

top_violation_types.title: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days (26 TAC §746.2421(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Two infants did not have current infant feeding schedules.

top_violation_types.title: AP Never exceed capacity of the home (26 TAC §747.207(10))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation was observed caring for thirteen children. The capacity on the permit is 12.

top_violation_types.title: Children's Records - Health Statement (26 TAC §747.603(a)(3))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One child is missing a health statement.
